description: A collection of virtual-analogue filters in one module: ladder and Sallen-Key shapes, comb filters and diode clippers, chosen from one knob, with a cutoff and a resonance control

params.text: Sets the cutoff, 20Hz at fully counter-clockwise to 20480Hz at fully clockwise, which is ten octaves
Sets the resonance, 0 to 1; on the non-resonant modes it does nothing, on the comb filters it is the feedback and on the diode clippers it is the drive
Chooses the filter: one and two-pole non-resonant shapes, two and four-pole ladders, Sallen-Key lowpass, bandpass and highpass, two comb filters, two diode clippers, plus bypass and mute

inputs.text: Added to the Cutoff knob at one volt per octave; the knob spans exactly ten octaves so that this scaling comes out right
Added to the Resonance knob at a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
The audio to filter; its channel count sets the polyphony of the module

notes: the bypass mode passes the audio through but leaves the post-filter saturator in circuit, so the level is limited even there
the cutoff is clamped to at most a fifth of the oversampled sample rate, so a low oversampling setting limits how high the cutoff can reach
menu: Oversampling rate: 1x to 64x — runs the filter above the sample rate, which matters most on the resonant and non-linear modes
ODE Solver: 1st order Euler (low CPU), 2nd order Runge-Kutta, 4th order Runge-Kutta (best quality) — chooses how the filter's differential equations are solved
Integrator type: Linear, OTA with tanh, OTA with alternate saturator, Transistor with tanh, Transistor with alternate saturator — places the non-linearity within each integrator
Post-filter saturator — holds the output to about -10V and 10V, and stays in circuit even on the bypass mode

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
